messages.content:
You are a bounded scientific Reviewer in MechCAL. Your review role is given in
the input. Your final review is concise natural language, not a JSON object.
When read_evidence is offered, you may query records in read_scope before writing
the review. Use its advertised paths and read_constraints, within the displayed
query allowance. Do not request scientific calculations, change rankings, invent observations, consult hidden
references or use an external scoring rubric.

Assess whether the stated arguments follow from the supplied observations,
consider alternatives, and identify a useful next test or explain why stopping
is reasonable. Advice does not approve or veto a state transition. Missing
scientific explanations should be feedback, not a format rejection.

For coverage_reviewer, identify plausible exploration directions from the input
and available capabilities. For reviewer, focus on changes and their sources;
previous_arguments are earlier judgments, not independent evidence. For
final_reviewer, check the exact final_proposal and assembled_answer against the
supplied facts, especially numerical values, units, conditions and limitations.
Suggest further computation when scientifically material, but acknowledge the
run_limits and distinguish missing evidence from a factual reporting error.
Use candidate_overview and pending_experiments to notice alternatives that have
not been tested. Prefer one useful comparison that could change the differential
over additional confirmation of the same three labels. Do not force a label
replacement, exhaustive tool coverage, or a fixed number of rounds.
Questions with scope=mechanism retain broader explanations; child tests may only
answer a prerequisite. Check both scopes before calling a comparison resolved.
Candidates may be complementary, not exclusive. question_evidence joins planned
comparisons to recorded conditions; never assume geometry/method equality from
a shared input reference. A useful executable contrast, a redundant calculation
and a capability gap are different reasons for continuing or stopping. Review
important unresolved questions outside the top three without forcing more runs.
Separate material factual errors from optional refinements. State the important
corrections together; do not repeatedly reopen settled facts without new evidence.
Changed wording is supplied again because it may change a scientific claim.
Unchanged sections need not be reread unless a change affects their interpretation.

You may name exact IDs from reference_ids in your prose when useful. Readability
does not imply citation eligibility. reference_contract is generated from the
same record identities used by the command validator: support_refs may support
claims, limitation_refs may document boundaries, and context_only_refs are not
valid in either evidence field. Follow-up questions and review receipts are
context, not evidence of a missing calculation. Describe that gap in prose, or
cite an actual failed operation if one exists. These IDs name records, not payload field names. The
initial molecular input is input:smiles. Failed calculations may explain missing
evidence, not establish a mechanism. Distinguish observations from inference.

execution_context links reviewed sources to their stored computation and request.
Request parameters describe what was attempted, not what succeeded. Only reported
effective_parameters describe executed settings; null means not recorded, not
equal to the request. A failed request identifies the attempted target but does
not establish a scientific observation. Input refs identify inputs, not additional
observations supplied here. Parameter values are exact; deferred paths were not
shown and must not be treated as absent or reviewed.
outputs names produced artifacts; geometry_records contains source-addressed
lineage and checks for the actual outputs. reported_geometry is a convenience
view only when one geometry record exists. Do not merge conflicting declarations
or infer missing provenance. These records are not scientific approval. A topology reference is not
the coordinate input. worker_interpretations contains unverified Worker prose,
deduplicated across a task's results, not additional independent evidence.
Compare that prose with execution_context and the cited observations. Do not
infer atom-map compatibility from matching orbital indices alone. Correct a
source, comparison or unsupported verification claim in the interpretation;
do not request recomputation merely to repair wording. A truncated preview can
be read at full_text_ref when relevant.
source_observations is the runtime's bounded copy of the Worker's exact prior
reads, not its prose. Check those original ref/path values before querying again;
other_reads lists deferred fields, not their values. Null means a legacy report
without retained observations, not an empty scientific result.
An already-correct Planner claim does not need repair merely because an archived
Worker explanation was wrong. Do not reopen corrected claims to rewrite history.
provenance gives complete or explicitly partial field lists for named containers
and exact recorded derivation flags. Check each stated source against its own
fields, not a matching value elsewhere. Flag a wrong source separately from a
wrong number. Reuse or recombination of descriptors is not independent validation.
An absent independence flag is unknown, not evidence of independence. Return
concrete source/path corrections together; no new computation is needed merely
to fix attribution or remove an unsupported independence claim.
citations contains the exact data selections used by Planner. These retain the
original JSON pointers and page offsets. component_excerpt is only a summary;
its source_index names the original components row. Never interpret the excerpt's
display order as the source array order. An omitted coefficient is not zero or
missing from the original record. Assess the supplied exact citation first.
Large observations are bounded views, not whole records. Deferred fields remain
available through read_evidence at their original paths. Inspect necessary unread
fields rather than declaring them absent. Request parameters and focus_tags are
intent, not detected features. Use explicit element and fragment labels in contact
tables; do not infer element identities from distances or array position.

The runtime records which materials were supplied for this review. You do not
need to return IDs, status, revision or other metadata. That review scope does
not mean every material supports a claim or has been endorsed by you.

Native inputs group current material under sections. A previous_review_ref/path
names an exact unchanged section in a saved review receipt, not an approval.
Previous feedback remains applicable unless addressed; report outstanding material
objections together with new findings. Read an unchanged section when needed to
evaluate interactions with changed claims. read_scope lists top-level paths;
each path_set names its top-level paths in read_path_sets. view=directory reveals
deeper fields. Source cards are previews, not full evidence.
A same_text_at object points to identical text at a JSON pointer in this message;
it is not a scientific source or a citation.
# Reading coverage
Read coverage applies only to the selected path. directory_only contains no
observations; partial_array cannot establish absence or a global extremum, even
when next_offset is null. Check a claimed extremum with reduce_evidence over the
original array. max_abs returns the magnitude and signed source rows. If you
cannot complete that check, report uncertainty rather than a factual correction
based on an unrepresentative page.

# Source-bound numerical checks

Use reduce_evidence for a sum or extremum and compare_evidence for a ratio or difference
instead of estimating these numbers from prose. Select an exact source ref and
JSON pointer. For min/max, path selects the complete array for the intended
condition and value_path selects the numeric field within each row, for example
/oscillator_strength. Empty value_path selects the numeric value itself.
For the largest signed coefficient by magnitude, use max_abs. Its value is a
magnitude; matches keep signed coefficients and exact original row identities.
This scans up to 100000 rows locally. A partial page, including a last page, cannot
establish a full-table maximum or absence. Read coverage applies only to its path.
For a fragment total, use reduction=sum and explicit row_indices from the original
array after checking its atom_index fields. A small per-atom maximum does not imply
a small fragment sum. Null row_indices includes the whole array, not an inferred
fragment. Subsets describe only the selected atoms, states or sampled geometries.
compare_evidence can reduce both operands in one query. These operations share
the existing read allowance and do not run scientific calculations.

Use the returned values, tied rows, conditions and exact source paths. Extrema
over different roots do not track the same physical state. Arithmetic does not
establish comparable methods, units, conformers or causal mechanisms. Explain
these limits in natural language. Cite the original records, not the numeric
receipt as independent evidence. If the required field or condition is unknown,
retrieve it or state the uncertainty; do not invent a numeric comparison.

MechCAL provides computationally supported preliminary mechanism judgments to
scientists. Experimental measurements are not available in this task. Compare
mechanisms through the available computational experiments and explain what the
results support. Missing wet-lab confirmation bounds a conclusion; it is not by
itself a reason to stop, reject useful computed evidence, or demote a candidate.
Do not confuse a calculated property or trend with proof of an operating mechanism.

Execution status comes from runtime. A completed calculation can leave its
scientific question inconclusive. In questions, assessment=distinguished means
the question itself has a bounded answer, not merely that a route ran. Use
inconclusive for an unresolved comparison, including when status is deferred or
resolved as a workflow disposition. Null means not assessed; legacy resolved
questions with null assessments still need consideration, not automatic clearance.

When scope/parent_id are recorded, a distinguished child test does not settle its
parent mechanism question. Consider the unresolved parent and relevant contenders
outside the Top-3. Complementary mechanisms need not defeat one another. In
question_evidence, compare actual execution conditions against the planned
contrast; different methods or optimized geometries are not matched controls.
Missing conditions remain unknown. Distinguish a useful next contrast from a
redundant test or a capability gap. Keep this in the existing bounded review,
not another required report or a demand for every question to be resolved.

Before delivery, review remaining computational opportunities against the live
tool_catalog. Do not infer all tools' abilities from one heuristic or a familiar
package name. ready permits an attempt, not guaranteed success. Missing input may
be obtainable by another available preparation step. Describe unfamiliar routes
before declaring that no available computation addresses a comparison.
Useful calculations may raise, lower, or leave candidate confidence unchanged.
Do not force new labels, all-tool coverage, confidence thresholds, or fixed rounds.

Only final_reviewer returns next_computations. Other Reviewer roles keep their
existing text/findings interface; do not add this field to those operations.
Final Reviewer: use the existing final review to identify at most three material next
computations, explaining what alternatives they could distinguish. These are
advice, not execution requests. Different comparisons may use the same tool;
different tool IDs do not establish independent evidence. Consider meaningful candidates beyond the current
Top-3, including deferred and formerly resolved comparisons. If no calculation
would help, return next_computations=[] and explain the computational reason,
not merely the absence of experiment. With unchanged computational_review.basis,
reuse its previous suggestions with next_computations=null; wording-only edits
do not require repeating exploration review. Tool metadata is not evidence.

candidate_comparison separates case-specific interpretations from source lineage
for the whole pool. In this same bounded review, compare unresolved contenders
against the same relevant observations, including candidates outside the Top-3.
State which explanations a shared observation distinguishes, which remain
compatible, and whether an available computation could separate them. Keep this
in the existing review text/findings and next_computations, not an extra report
or mandatory per-label checklist. Read alternative sources when relevant; lack
of a measurement is not a negative result. A failed narrow explanation does not
redefine or disprove its broader mechanism family. If available computations
cannot separate the explanations, recommend a provisional ordering with that
uncertainty. Reuse the current review when its basis has not changed.

Planner: when final review suggests a route, perform a useful computation, choose
an alternative, or explain why the suggestion would not distinguish the candidates.
To submit the saved draft instead, use route_responses for the current suggestions.
Give one response per distinct capability, addressing all its proposed comparisons.
Disagreement is allowed. Do not use an unavailable or unexecuted calculation as
negative evidence. Retain unresolved mechanisms and communicate the preliminary
ranking and the remaining discriminating questions without repeating all history.

We are coverage_reviewer at command_coverage stage. There are no executions, no ranking, no observations beyond input SMILES. My task: identify plausible exploration directions from input and available capabilities; early-stage coverage review. I should not request unnecessary reads — there's basically nothing to read (no executions). Maybe check investigation:state? It's empty choices. followup:state no impacts. Probably I could just deliver review without queries, or do a quick read to confirm no prior choices. Query turns remaining 2; reads don't consume computation allowance.

Given the molecule: cyanide-gold pentafluorophenyl complex with decyloxy-phenyl: an isocyanide-Au(I) aryl complex, likely luminescent gold complex. Mechanism candidates: RIM, ICT/TICT, triplet/metal energy transfer (Au heavy atom → phosphorescence), packing, aggregate, radiative rate, RACI, SOKR, PET/ET, ESIPT (unlikely — no acidic proton donor), host-guest.

I should give plausible exploration directions using available tools. Prerequisites: no prepared_structure, so first step is microscopic.optimize_ground_state_geometry (ready) to get prepared_structure. Then a bundle: run_baseline_bundle (S0/S1), bright/dark state ordering, torsion snapshots for RIM, conformer bundle, frontier orbital partition and CT descriptors for ICT, compare_singlet_triplet_states / evaluate_spin_orbit_couplings for triplet metal, estimate SOC disabled, estimate_vertical_ip_ea for PET (though PET unlikely in this system—no electron donor/acceptor pair to quench; well, decyloxy-phenyl is electron rich donor and Au-CN acceptor? possible).

Macro proxies are cheap low-cost: screen_rotor_rim_prior, screen_metal_triplet_prior, screen_esipt_structural_motif (expect negative — checks whether ESIPT should be dropped), screen_aggregation_prone_scaffold, run_crystal_restriction_checklist. These are structural priors, not mechanism evidence, but useful for prioritization at zero microscopic cost.

I should recommend first: macro structure scan + metal triplet prior + rotor/rim prior to triage (fast), while acknowledging they are proxies. Then ground-state optimization to unlock microscopic path — critical bottleneck: almost all microscopic tools missing prepared_structure.

Also flag ESIPT likely low priority given no protic donor (C-F, ether O with no H attached to heteroatom), but that's an inference from structure; the screen_esipt_structural_motif can confirm as a proxy.

Also SOKR requires multiple emission bands; torsion scans / bright-dark ordering can inform.

Also RACI: evaluate_cis_s1_gradient, scan_cis_excitation_coordinate could probe CI access, but excited-state relaxation disabled — capability gap.

I should keep findings concise, source refs: findings likely allowed with source_refs of review_source=true rows: followup:state, investigation:state, input:smiles. But findings format... The delivery is natural language. I'll just write prose without formal findings JSON. Actually role interface is "text/findings". I'll deliver natural language; no need for source refs since nothing to cite beyond input:smiles.

Let me decide whether to query. Maybe read investigation:state and followup:state quickly to confirm no prior choices — but the context already shows computational_review.executions empty and investigation.current_choice null. That's sufficient. I'll do one small read? Query turns are limited but reads don't consume computation. It may be worth checking /choices in investigation state and followup questions. The supplied structured fields already display them (empty). I'll skip queries and deliver.

Structure the review:

- Basis: no executions, no ranking, so this is a cold-start coverage review; the input is a single SMILES, no geometry.
- Bottleneck: every microscopic tool needs prepared_structure; only optimize_ground_state_geometry is ready. So first useful action is geometry optimization, which unlocks baseline bundle, torsion scans, conformer probes etc. Note optimistic: optimization success not guaranteed (Amesp aTB1 BFGS).
- Cheap triage proxies that are ready and info-bearing: screen_metal_triplet_prior, screen_rotor_rim_prior, screen_planarity_compactness/donor_acceptor_architecture, screen_aggregation_prone_scaffold, screen_esipt_structural_motif, run_crystal_restriction_checklist, run_water_fraction_aggregation_checklist. Explicitly labeled structural priors, not mechanism evidence; but they can prioritize which family to test microscopically and can prune ESIPT.
- After prepared_structure: run_baseline_bundle (S0/S1 vertical states) and run_frontier_orbital_partition / extract_ct_descriptors_from_bundle to test ICT vs local excitation — key split: ICT/TICT vs radiative rate balance vs triplet.
- RIM vs packing: run_torsion_snapshots or run_torsion_brightness_coupling_scan on the Au–CN–aryl / C–O bonds; conformer_state_probe for conformational spread; these support RIM (molecular motion) whereas packing/confinement requires dimer/aggregate context: search_dimer_contacts, scan_intermolecular_distance, compare_contact_torsion_response, run_dimer_packing_proxy. Note that compare_contact_torsion_response is a genuinely discriminating test: same torsion in monomer vs modeled dimer isolates contact effect. But requires prepared_structure.
- Triplet/metal: compare_singlet_triplet_states (TD-DFTB/mio-1-1, CHNO only? tool 63 says CHNO param... "evaluate_excited_state_gradient: CHNO par" — for compare_spin_states_pyscf there's scalar Au ECP and def2 basis — better for a Au complex). Note compare_spin_states_pyscf is explicitly Au-capable (scalar Au ECP); evaluate_spin_orbit_couplings uses TD-DFTB/mio-1-1 which may not handle Au. That's a real capability caveat worth naming. estimate_soc_amesp is disabled.
- SOKR: needs evidence of emission from higher excited state — bright/dark state ordering plus S2/S1 gap and oscillator strengths; but no emission measurements available. So likely deferred/limited.
- PET_ET: estimate_vertical_ip_ea for the donor (decyloxy-phenyl) and acceptor fragments; note it's not a rate. In this system intramolecular PET seems unlikely; charge-transfer (ICT) is the more natural interpretation of the same donor-acceptor evidence, so they are partly complementary/overlapping; distinguishing requires CT descriptors/localized orbital analysis vs full electron transfer — hard with available tools.
- ESIPT: no transferable proton on the acceptor side; fluorines and ether O; likely low priority, screen_esipt_structural_motif as cheap check.
- HOST_GUEST_INTERACTION: no host specified in inputs; requires a host material, not derivable. Capability gap / out of scope unless host chosen.
- Also note: no emission/experimental data — computational results bound conclusion.
- Capability gaps: excited-state relaxation disabled (run_excited_state_relaxation, scan_excited_state_coordinate, extract_torsion_candidates_from_bundle, estimate_soc_amesp) so RACI and geometry-relaxed excited-state claims cannot be computed; also no nonadiabatic dynamics.

Recommend a concrete first step: ground-state optimize then cheap proxies? Order: since proxies are zero-cost-ish and ready now, run metal_triplet_prior + rotor_rim_prior + donor_acceptor_architecture first, then optimize geometry.

Keep concise.

## Coverage review — cold start, no executions, no ranking

**Basis of this review.** `computational_review.executions` and `comparisons` are both empty, `candidate_overview` is entirely unassessed, and the only supplied observation is the input structure `input:smiles` (`CCCCCCCCCCOc1ccc([N+]#[C-]->[Au]c2c(F)c(F)c(F)c(F)c2F)cc1`). So there is no argument to check for internal consistency yet; what follows is a coverage judgment about which comparisons would actually separate the eleven labels, and which are currently blocked by prerequisites rather than by evidence.

**The binding constraint is a missing `prepared_structure`, not a missing capability.** Exactly one microscopic route is `ready` (`microscopic.optimize_ground_state_geometry`); essentially every other microscopic tool — baseline bundle, bright/dark ordering, frontier-orbital partition, CT descriptors, hole/electron analysis, torsion and conformer probes, dimer contact searches, spin-state and SOC comparisons — is `missing_input: prepared_structure`. Until a geometry exists, any discussion of ICT vs triplet vs RIM is unfalsifiable by computation. That optimization is therefore the highest-value single action, with the caveat that an Amesp aTB1 BFGS run on a Au isocyanide complex is an attempt, not a guaranteed success.

**Useful triage that is available now, before geometry.** The macro proxy family is `ready` and cheap, and the input molecule makes several of them informative for ordering rather than for scoring: `macro.screen_metal_triplet_prior` (Au heavy atom plus perfluoroaryl), `macro.screen_rotor_rim_prior` and `macro.screen_rotor_torsion_topology` (decyloxy chain, aryl–O, Au–CN–aryl torsions), `macro.screen_donor_acceptor_architecture` / `screen_donor_acceptor_layout` (alkoxy-aryl donor against the cationic Au–CN acceptor). These carry the catalog's own disclaimer — structural priors, not mechanism evidence — so they should order the microscopic queue, not populate any confidence.

**The most informative microscopic contrasts, once a geometry exists.** I would treat these as four different questions rather than three confirmations of one:

- *Local vs charge-transfer character of the emissive state*: `run_baseline_bundle` plus `extract_ct_descriptors_from_bundle`, `analyze_hole_electron_from_bundle`, and `run_frontier_orbital_partition`. This is the natural separator between ICT_TICT_CT and RADIATIVE_RATE_STATE_BALANCE, which otherwise share any single oscillator-strength observation.
- *Intramolecular motion vs environment confinement*: `run_torsion_snapshots` / `run_torsion_brightness_coupling_scan` and `run_conformer_state_probe` address RIM_RIR_RIV in isolation; `search_dimer_contacts`, `scan_intermolecular_distance`, and especially `compare_contact_torsion_response` address PACKING_HOST_MATRIX_CONFINEMENT. `compare_contact_torsion_response` is the one route here that isolates contact effects by holding the same torsion/azimuth fixed in monomer vs modeled dimer, and is worth reserving for after geometry rather than duplicating the monomer torsion scan.
- *Metal/triplet channel*: `compare_spin_states_pyscf` is the better-matched capability for this element set (explicit scalar Au ECP, def2 basis), whereas `evaluate_spin_orbit_couplings` and `compare_singlet_triplet_states` run TD-DFTB/mio-1-1 and should not be assumed to parameterize Au — that is a real capability caveat to check before treating a null result as counterevidence. `estimate_soc_amesp` is `disabled`, so quantitative SOC is not available now.
- *Aggregation/excimer*: only proxy-level routes (`screen_aggregation_prone_scaffold`, `run_dimer_packing_proxy`, `run_aggregate_contact_proxy`) plus the dimer tools; none constructs a real aggregate or reports exciton splitting, so AGGREGATE_EXCITON_EXCIMER is likely to remain a prior-weighted label rather than a computed one.

**Rows that look low-yield and why.** ESIPT_PT has no plausible transferable proton acceptor/donor pair in this structure — no heteroatom-bound hydrogen on the fluorinated ring or the ether oxygen; `macro.screen_esipt_structural_motif` is a cheap explicit check that could justify dropping it, but the structural read is already adverse and this is inference, not a measurement. HOST_GUEST_INTERACTION has no host in the inputs at all; it needs a host/material specification that cannot be derived from the SMILES, so it is a genuine input gap, not a missing calculation. SOKR_ANTI_KASHA is testable only indirectly (bright/dark ordering, S2–S1 gap and relative oscillator strengths) and cannot be confirmed without resolution of more than one emission band, which is not available computationaly here.

**Two mechanisms that overlap rather than compete.** PET_ET and ICT_TICT_CT draw on the same donor–acceptor topology; `estimate_vertical_ip_ea` gives a bounded IP/EA proxy (explicitly not a transfer rate) and `estimate_vertical_ip_ea`-style evidence would not by itself separate full electron transfer from internal charge transfer. In this intramolecular, covalently linked alkoxyaryl–Au(isocyanide) system, ICT is the more natural reading of a shared CT observation, and PET_ET should be retained as a complementary but lower-priority member rather than treated as excluded.

**Capability gaps to record, not evidence against any family.** Excited-state relaxation, excited-state coordinate scans, CIS/pyrazine-style path scans, `extract_torsion_candidates_from_bundle`, and Amesp SOC estimates are disabled; CI/nonadiabatic dynamics are unsupported. Consequently RACI_CI_ACCESS can be probed only indirectly (`evaluate_cis_s1_gradient`, `scan_cis_excitation_coordinate` on fixed geometries) and should not be resolved as absent merely because the path-scale tools are unavailable.

**Suggested ordering for the next exploration step.** (1) Run `macro.screen_metal_triplet_prior`, `macro.screen_rotor_rim_prior`, and `macro.screen_donor_acceptor_architecture` for triage; (2) `microscopic.optimize_ground_state_geometry` to clear the common prerequisite; (3) then one CT/local-character panel and one torsion-response comparison — those two contrasts, taken together, discriminate the ICT, RIM, and triplet-metal versus state-balance explanations with the fewest runs. No ranking, confidence, or label set is endorsed by this review; the run limits (3 exploration rounds, 3 computations) are consistent with that plan.

messages.content:
You are MechCAL's scientific Planner. Use the supplied SMILES, fixed mechanism
pool and case-local computational evidence to produce a bounded preliminary
mechanism ranking. No papers, hidden reference, judge feedback or rubric are
available. Experimental measurements are not available; use computational evidence.
Scientific decisions remain yours; Reviewer and Worker outputs are
advice, not verdicts. Compare credible explanations, what has weakened, and which
next observation could distinguish alternatives, including those outside Top-3.
Mechanisms can coexist. Do not force a new label, confidence movement, exhaustive
tool coverage or a fixed number of rounds. Missing wet-lab confirmation bounds
the claim; it alone neither invalidates computation nor demands more work.

CURRENT WORK
This is the current task view, not a restart. It includes the current assessment,
new-result addresses, active issues, authorized input addresses and retained
facts. Earlier API requests are not implicit memory. Use the delivered working
facts and latest operation result; retrieve missing context rather than assume
you remember it. Omitted data is not absent, zero, refuted or approved. Candidate
confidence and experiment value are different. A failed explanation does not
disprove its entire mechanism family. Consider useful controlled comparisons,
redundant tests and real capability gaps before stopping.

READS AND DOCUMENTATION
Native function schemas and operation_groups define available operations and
batching. Detailed manuals are stored at context:planner under
/fields/operation_guides/<name>, with names in operation_guide_names. Read an
exact needed manual using read_evidence, or read_context for a named background
field. Do not fetch the entire background to acknowledge an update. In a query
continuation, the smaller catalog is navigation, not full tool documentation.
describe_tools loads exact parameter contracts, prerequisites and output meaning.
Missing inputs may be obtainable with another allowed preparation tool; ready
permits an attempt, not guaranteed success. Read unfamiliar route details before
declaring a capability gap. Deferred material remains accessible, not prechecked.

Copy record IDs exactly. Keep IDs and JSON-pointer paths separate. Index rows
are navigation, not observations. Use report_ref/brief_read for a compact report;
report fields differ from raw result paths. For large sources, inspect a
directory then read relevant paths or a page. Respect operation_policy and the
remaining query allowance. Workspace reads do not refill scientific queries.
Use exact source-bound numerical operations when needed, not invented arithmetic.
same_text_at and same_data_at are exact request-local pointers, not citations.

ASSESSMENT AND COMPUTATION
Before experiments and after each result group, use update_hypotheses to maintain
the provisional assessment. Update changed entries only; an empty change list
can explicitly retain it. Confidence is subjective, may stay null/unchanged and
need not sum to one. Keep case-specific explanations, not just labels. Address
relevant impact suggestions as reviewed, deferred or dismissed; omission leaves
them pending. Use brief questions and planned contrasting outcomes when useful,
not as a mandatory checklist. A narrow child test does not settle its parent
mechanism question. New observations can affect several mechanisms at once.

When investigation_policy is present, record investigate or conclude with a
brief reason in update_hypotheses.investigation. An investigate choice may use a
saved question or null for preparation. Evaluate new proposal_decision options
by possible outcomes, not just previous argument approval. Choosing does not
execute. operation_groups may allow the update followed by a computation or one
control in the same response; use that instead of a separate acknowledgement.
Only requested native functions execute, never prose next_test suggestions.

Choose tools, atom selections, scientific parameters and existing artifact IDs
explicitly. The runtime never invents inputs or substitutes tools. Independent
batched computations cannot consume a sibling's future result. For delegation,
select an owner, authorized capabilities and input_refs including the starting
structure. Bind scientific conditions such as state or multiplicity. Scope
operational source IDs to their own capability, not every downstream tool. A
Worker can diagnose execution failures within that authorization, not change the
scientific question. Failed calculations are limitations, not negative physical
evidence. Pending experiments remain visible: explicitly retry or cancel them.

EVIDENCE AND REVIEW
Cite original observations in refs; input:smiles can support structural priors.
Put failed/unavailable operations in limitation_refs only. Reports, explanations,
manuals, reviews and remembered judgments are not new observations. Bind numeric
claims to their own source paths, execution conditions and actual status. Parent
result paths do not belong to a child evidence unit. Reuse of a result or a
derived score is not independent confirmation. Unrecorded conditions remain
unknown; optimized structures or different methods are not matched controls.
Computation success does not mean the scientific comparison is distinguished.

Formal arguments and rankings are separate from provisional assessment. Submit
only changed records, with linked argument/ranking changes in one transaction.
Explanations belong in arguments, rankings link argument_ids. Omitted records
persist; null edit fields are unchanged and [] clears a list. Accepted edits
stay accepted after reads. Correct related factual errors together. Science
disagreements and optional wording are not mandatory correction gates. Only
Reviewer closes tracked issues. request_review is for needed scientific review,
not copy-editing or acknowledgement. Full prior advice is readable when previewed.

LOCAL ERRORS AND DELIVERY
Each operation result says what executed or committed; an assistant request is
not proof of success. Correct rejected fields, choose another route or state the
limitation. For judgment_draft use repair_judgment on displayed change indices
or discard_judgment; the draft is uncommitted and repairs are atomic. These
native repair tools are version-bound by runtime. Consult the saved exact fields
instead of repeating correct paragraphs. Ordinary errors do not erase evidence.

When further feasible comparisons would not materially improve the judgment,
record a conclude choice and retain unresolved alternatives honestly. finalize
saves a concise narrative alongside predictions assembled from accepted claims.
amend_final edits a saved draft; review_final retries its review without rewriting.
submit_final delivers the exact reviewed draft_id. Changed content needs review
again, but review is advisory, not approval. Address final route suggestions in
route_responses, accepting or declining with a computational reason. Do not claim
an available route is unavailable just because you chose not to run it. Consult
the exact operation guide for unfamiliar editing or submission details.

paths.description: Exact JSON pointers from the record root, e.g. /structured_results/parsed_observables. Use advertised paths, not bare field names. An empty list reads the whole record.

page.description: For directory, page through children. For data, select one list path and page its rows. Null preserves complete reads. Responses are limited to 24000 bytes.

tools.name: reduce_evidence

path.description: Exact source JSON pointer. For array reductions, select the original array for the intended condition, not a displayed page.

value_path.description: Relative JSON pointer to the numeric field, e.g. /oscillator_strength in each selected array row. Empty for numbers. Missing/non-numeric values are rejected, never skipped.

row_indices.description: Optional distinct zero-based ARRAY ROW indices for array reductions. Null selects every row. These are not atom IDs. Verify each row's atom_index or state identity before selecting a fragment or state subset.

We need to start cold: no computations, no ranking. Need to plan bounded preliminary mechanism ranking with molecule-specific evidence. We have 3 computations allowance, 2 scientific reads remaining, 12 worker model calls, max 4 computations delegated.

Molecule: 1-decyloxy-4-(isocyanoaurio-tetrafluorophenyl)benzene? Actually SMILES: CCCCCCCCCCOc1ccc([N+]#[C-]->[Au]c2c(F)c(F)c(F)c(F)c2F)cc1. This is an aryl isocyanide-gold(I) pentafluorophenyl complex with decyloxy tail. This is a classic AIE / luminescence gold isocyanide complex? Gold(I) isocyanide complexes with pentafluorophenyl and alkoxyaryl — known for mechanochromic luminescence, aurophilic interactions, RIM, packing. The family pool: likely top hypotheses: PACKING_HOST_MATRIX_CONFINEMENT (crystal/solid-state confinement), RIM_RIR_RIV (rotor restriction of alkoxy chain/aryl), TRIPLET_METAL_ENERGY_TRANSFER (Au heavy atom, phosphorescence), AGGREGATE_EXCITON_EXCIMER, RADIATIVE_RATE_STATE_BALANCE, ICT_TICT_CT (donor alkoxy aryl to isocyanide/Au acceptor).

We need computational evidence. First step: optimize ground state geometry from structure:initial (recover prepared_structure). Then run baseline bundle to get S0/S1, oscillator strengths, states. Then frontier orbital partition / CT descriptors / hole-electron analysis to assess ICT. Also charge population panel. Potential triplet compare_spin_states or compare_singlet_triplet_states. But Au-containing; Amesp aTB1 may handle? Baseline says typed fallback. The microscopic optimize_ground_state_geometry uses Amesp aTB1 ground-state forces. Could work with Au? Amesp may have Au parameters? Uncertain. PF6? No.

We need be efficient: 3 computations. Could delegate one worker with multiple computations: optimize_ground_state_geometry, run_baseline_bundle, extract_ct_descriptors_from_bundle, run_frontier_orbital_partition, analyze_hole_electron maybe. That's 1 delegated objective with 4 computations within worker. Planner compute allowance 3 maybe worker max 4. We can delegate a bundle.

But before compute, should update_hypotheses (assessment_required true) with initial confidence, explanations, and investigation choice. Since no evidence yet, confidence null? We can assign low/moderate prior from structure. Need use update_hypotheses. It may accompany next computation in same response per rules: update_hypotheses may precede available computations or one listed control. We can do update_hypotheses then delegate_computation in same response? "hypothesis_followup_controls" includes delegate_computation and revise_judgment. It says update_hypotheses may precede available computations or ONE listed hypothesis_followup_control. So yes, update then delegate.

Need perhaps read operation guide for planner_worker_tasks and computational_mission to get delegation exact. We have 2 scientific reads remaining, 2 context reads. We should read guides. read_evidence on context:planner /fields/operation_guides/planner_worker_tasks and /fields/operation_guides/planner_exploration_state maybe. Also read review feedback full? Review preview says cold start; no need maybe. We should read operation guides. Use read_evidence with 2 paths. Workspace refs? operation_policy scientific_reads_remaining 2. Let's read planner_worker_tasks and computational_mission? Limit 2. Could read one call with 2 records? read_evidence accepts up to 6 records and 8 paths per record. That's one operation, but "scientific_reads_remaining:2" maybe count selections? We can read two paths. Let's do planner_worker_tasks and planner_exploration_state in one read_evidence call? Better exact.

We also may need describe_tools for capabilities to know output parameters; but description_batches_remaining 2, can load 6 capabilities. Could load optimize_ground_state_geometry, run_baseline_bundle, extract_ct_descriptors_from_bundle, run_frontier_orbital_partition, compare_singlet_triplet_states, estimate_vertical_ip_ea maybe. But description may be verbose. We know enough from catalog but exact parameters matter for delegation fixed_parameters. Worker can choose? We need specify inputs. We should read guide.

Let's read the operations guide for worker tasks and computational mission.

parent_id.description: Optional broader question ID in this case. Null/omission retains it; empty string detaches. Answering this question never answers its parent automatically. Null or omission retains the saved field. New questions require labels and question. May be omitted for no change.

relation.description: Planner's interpretation of the named candidates for this question, not a taxonomy rule. Null/omission retains the saved value. Null or omission retains the saved field. New questions require labels and question. May be omitted for no change.

assessment.description: Scientific answer to this question, separate from whether a calculation finished. Null means not assessed, including legacy records. route.description: Optional exact available route for this comparison; not an executable request. Parameters are supplied to the computation tool separately. Null or omission retains the saved field. New questions require labels and question. May be omitted for no change.

disposition_reason.description: Why a test is deferred or the comparison is resolved, if applicable. Null or omission retains the saved field. New questions require labels and question. May be omitted for no change.

clear_fields.description: Explicitly clear these optional fields. Do not also supply a non-null replacement for them. May be omitted for no change.

considered_question_ids.description: Other saved comparisons actually considered, not a list of all mechanisms or a required coverage quota.

reason.description: Briefly compare the information expected from the next experiment with the alternatives, or explain why remaining feasible comparisons do not justify continuing. Scientific disagreement is allowed.

baseline_refs.description: Existing case-local inputs or results for comparison, not copied measurements.

confidence.description: Current subjective confidence, not calibrated probability. Null means unassessed, not zero.

explanation.description: Current case-specific physical explanation for this family, separate from confidence-change notes. Null or omission retains the previous explanation; empty string clears it. This is interpretation, not evidence.

question_id.description: Saved question selected for investigation; null for preparation or open exploration, and for conclusion.

considered_question_ids.description: Other saved comparisons actually considered, not a list of all mechanisms or a required coverage quota.

reason.description: Briefly compare the information expected from the next experiment with the alternatives, or explain why remaining feasible comparisons do not justify continuing. Scientific disagreement is allowed.

changes.description: May be omitted for no change.

note.description: Brief assessment of the available new results, or why confidence remains unchanged or unresolved.

responses.description: May be omitted for no change.

questions.description: May be omitted for no change.

investigation.description: Next investigation choice, separate from confidence. May accompany the computation or finalize in the same response. Omit to retain a still-current choice; runtime manages its version. May be omitted for no change.

tools.description: Save provisional confidence changes or explicitly retain the current assessment. Not a formal argument or final ranking. May accompany the next computation in one response.

messages.content:
You are MechCAL's scientific Planner. Use the supplied SMILES, fixed mechanism
pool and case-local computational evidence to produce a bounded preliminary
mechanism ranking. No papers, hidden reference, judge feedback or rubric are
available. Experimental measurements are not available; use computational evidence.
Scientific decisions remain yours; Reviewer and Worker outputs are
advice, not verdicts. Compare credible explanations, what has weakened, and which
next observation could distinguish alternatives, including those outside Top-3.
Mechanisms can coexist. Do not force a new label, confidence movement, exhaustive
tool coverage or a fixed number of rounds. Missing wet-lab confirmation bounds
the claim; it alone neither invalidates computation nor demands more work.

CURRENT WORK
This is the current task view, not a restart. It includes the current assessment,
new-result addresses, active issues, authorized input addresses and retained
facts. Earlier API requests are not implicit memory. Use the delivered working
facts and latest operation result; retrieve missing context rather than assume
you remember it. Omitted data is not absent, zero, refuted or approved. Candidate
confidence and experiment value are different. A failed explanation does not
disprove its entire mechanism family. Consider useful controlled comparisons,
redundant tests and real capability gaps before stopping.

READS AND DOCUMENTATION
Native function schemas and operation_groups define available operations and
batching. Detailed manuals are stored at context:planner under
/fields/operation_guides/<name>, with names in operation_guide_names. Read an
exact needed manual using read_evidence, or read_context for a named background
field. Do not fetch the entire background to acknowledge an update. In a query
continuation, the smaller catalog is navigation, not full tool documentation.
describe_tools loads exact parameter contracts, prerequisites and output meaning.
Missing inputs may be obtainable with another allowed preparation tool; ready
permits an attempt, not guaranteed success. Read unfamiliar route details before
declaring a capability gap. Deferred material remains accessible, not prechecked.

Copy record IDs exactly. Keep IDs and JSON-pointer paths separate. Index rows
are navigation, not observations. Use report_ref/brief_read for a compact report;
report fields differ from raw result paths. For large sources, inspect a
directory then read relevant paths or a page. Respect operation_policy and the
remaining query allowance. Workspace reads do not refill scientific queries.
Use exact source-bound numerical operations when needed, not invented arithmetic.
same_text_at and same_data_at are exact request-local pointers, not citations.

ASSESSMENT AND COMPUTATION
Before experiments and after each result group, use update_hypotheses to maintain
the provisional assessment. Update changed entries only; an empty change list
can explicitly retain it. Confidence is subjective, may stay null/unchanged and
need not sum to one. Keep case-specific explanations, not just labels. Address
relevant impact suggestions as reviewed, deferred or dismissed; omission leaves
them pending. Use brief questions and planned contrasting outcomes when useful,
not as a mandatory checklist. A narrow child test does not settle its parent
mechanism question. New observations can affect several mechanisms at once.

When investigation_policy is present, record investigate or conclude with a
brief reason in update_hypotheses.investigation. An investigate choice may use a
saved question or null for preparation. Evaluate new proposal_decision options
by possible outcomes, not just previous argument approval. Choosing does not
execute. operation_groups may allow the update followed by a computation or one
control in the same response; use that instead of a separate acknowledgement.
Only requested native functions execute, never prose next_test suggestions.

Choose tools, atom selections, scientific parameters and existing artifact IDs
explicitly. The runtime never invents inputs or substitutes tools. Independent
batched computations cannot consume a sibling's future result. For delegation,
select an owner, authorized capabilities and input_refs including the starting
structure. Bind scientific conditions such as state or multiplicity. Scope
operational source IDs to their own capability, not every downstream tool. A
Worker can diagnose execution failures within that authorization, not change the
scientific question. Failed calculations are limitations, not negative physical
evidence. Pending experiments remain visible: explicitly retry or cancel them.

EVIDENCE AND REVIEW
Cite original observations in refs; input:smiles can support structural priors.
Put failed/unavailable operations in limitation_refs only. Reports, explanations,
manuals, reviews and remembered judgments are not new observations. Bind numeric
claims to their own source paths, execution conditions and actual status. Parent
result paths do not belong to a child evidence unit. Reuse of a result or a
derived score is not independent confirmation. Unrecorded conditions remain
unknown; optimized structures or different methods are not matched controls.
Computation success does not mean the scientific comparison is distinguished.

Formal arguments and rankings are separate from provisional assessment. Submit
only changed records, with linked argument/ranking changes in one transaction.
Explanations belong in arguments, rankings link argument_ids. Omitted records
persist; null edit fields are unchanged and [] clears a list. Accepted edits
stay accepted after reads. Correct related factual errors together. Science
disagreements and optional wording are not mandatory correction gates. Only
Reviewer closes tracked issues. request_review is for needed scientific review,
not copy-editing or acknowledgement. Full prior advice is readable when previewed.

LOCAL ERRORS AND DELIVERY
Each operation result says what executed or committed; an assistant request is
not proof of success. Correct rejected fields, choose another route or state the
limitation. For judgment_draft use repair_judgment on displayed change indices
or discard_judgment; the draft is uncommitted and repairs are atomic. These
native repair tools are version-bound by runtime. Consult the saved exact fields
instead of repeating correct paragraphs. Ordinary errors do not erase evidence.

When further feasible comparisons would not materially improve the judgment,
record a conclude choice and retain unresolved alternatives honestly. finalize
saves a concise narrative alongside predictions assembled from accepted claims.
amend_final edits a saved draft; review_final retries its review without rewriting.
submit_final delivers the exact reviewed draft_id. Changed content needs review
again, but review is advisory, not approval. Address final route suggestions in
route_responses, accepting or declining with a computational reason. Do not claim
an available route is unavailable just because you chose not to run it. Consult
the exact operation guide for unfamiliar editing or submission details.

content.text:
We need to start cold: no computations, no ranking. Need to plan bounded preliminary mechanism ranking with molecule-specific evidence. We have 3 computations allowance, 2 scientific reads remaining, 12 worker model calls, max 4 computations delegated.

Molecule: 1-decyloxy-4-(isocyanoaurio-tetrafluorophenyl)benzene? Actually SMILES: CCCCCCCCCCOc1ccc([N+]#[C-]->[Au]c2c(F)c(F)c(F)c(F)c2F)cc1. This is an aryl isocyanide-gold(I) pentafluorophenyl complex with decyloxy tail. This is a classic AIE / luminescence gold isocyanide complex? Gold(I) isocyanide complexes with pentafluorophenyl and alkoxyaryl — known for mechanochromic luminescence, aurophilic interactions, RIM, packing. The family pool: likely top hypotheses: PACKING_HOST_MATRIX_CONFINEMENT (crystal/solid-state confinement), RIM_RIR_RIV (rotor restriction of alkoxy chain/aryl), TRIPLET_METAL_ENERGY_TRANSFER (Au heavy atom, phosphorescence), AGGREGATE_EXCITON_EXCIMER, RADIATIVE_RATE_STATE_BALANCE, ICT_TICT_CT (donor alkoxy aryl to isocyanide/Au acceptor).

We need computational evidence. First step: optimize ground state geometry from structure:initial (recover prepared_structure). Then run baseline bundle to get S0/S1, oscillator strengths, states. Then frontier orbital partition / CT descriptors / hole-electron analysis to assess ICT. Also charge population panel. Potential triplet compare_spin_states or compare_singlet_triplet_states. But Au-containing; Amesp aTB1 may handle? Baseline says typed fallback. The microscopic optimize_ground_state_geometry uses Amesp aTB1 ground-state forces. Could work with Au? Amesp may have Au parameters? Uncertain. PF6? No.

We need be efficient: 3 computations. Could delegate one worker with multiple computations: optimize_ground_state_geometry, run_baseline_bundle, extract_ct_descriptors_from_bundle, run_frontier_orbital_partition, analyze_hole_electron maybe. That's 1 delegated objective with 4 computations within worker. Planner compute allowance 3 maybe worker max 4. We can delegate a bundle.

But before compute, should update_hypotheses (assessment_required true) with initial confidence, explanations, and investigation choice. Since no evidence yet, confidence null? We can assign low/moderate prior from structure. Need use update_hypotheses. It may accompany next computation in same response per rules: update_hypotheses may precede available computations or one listed control. We can do update_hypotheses then delegate_computation in same response? "hypothesis_followup_controls" includes delegate_computation and revise_judgment. It says update_hypotheses may precede available computations or ONE listed hypothesis_followup_control. So yes, update then delegate.

Need perhaps read operation guide for planner_worker_tasks and computational_mission to get delegation exact. We have 2 scientific reads remaining, 2 context reads. We should read guides. read_evidence on context:planner /fields/operation_guides/planner_worker_tasks and /fields/operation_guides/planner_exploration_state maybe. Also read review feedback full? Review preview says cold start; no need maybe. We should read operation guides. Use read_evidence with 2 paths. Workspace refs? operation_policy scientific_reads_remaining 2. Let's read planner_worker_tasks and computational_mission? Limit 2. Could read one call with 2 records? read_evidence accepts up to 6 records and 8 paths per record. That's one operation, but "scientific_reads_remaining:2" maybe count selections? We can read two paths. Let's do planner_worker_tasks and planner_exploration_state in one read_evidence call? Better exact.

We also may need describe_tools for capabilities to know output parameters; but description_batches_remaining 2, can load 6 capabilities. Could load optimize_ground_state_geometry, run_baseline_bundle, extract_ct_descriptors_from_bundle, run_frontier_orbital_partition, compare_singlet_triplet_states, estimate_vertical_ip_ea maybe. But description may be verbose. We know enough from catalog but exact parameters matter for delegation fixed_parameters. Worker can choose? We need specify inputs. We should read guide.

Let's read the operations guide for worker tasks and computational mission.

Keep scientific decisions and rankings yourself.

artifact_index keeps a short list of existing inputs; its full directory remains queryable in memory. Include the selected starting artifact in input_refs before delegation. The Worker cannot search unrelated case records. The runtime checks whether an authorized input path can start; it does not choose a source for you or require intermediate products to exist before their producing step.

For state-specific work bind state_root (or the relevant target-state parameter) in fixed_parameters. Bind essential scientific parameters when they are exposed by the tool; do not invent unavailable parameters. For methods fixed by the backend, restrict the authorized capabilities accordingly. Only numerical execution settings may be changed freely; a change in the scientific question requires a new delegation. Input refs may include prior failed results for diagnosis plus the source artifacts. A task returns complete, partial or blocked with record IDs and a prose explanation. Read those results when needed; do not interpret task completion as mechanism support. Direct exact compute calls remain available.

Each fixed parameter has an optional capability_id. Null means a task-wide condition for every tool exposing that parameter, appropriate for charge, multiplicity or target state. Scope operational inputs to their own capability. For example, bind source_artifact_id to the initial structure only for optimize_ground_state_geometry; run_baseline_bundle then needs the resulting prepared structure, and hole-electron analysis needs the resulting baseline bundle. Likewise, a member_id used by select_computed_geometry does not fix the input of a later analysis. input_refs grants access to records, not a requirement to reuse the same source ID at every step. Do not globally lock a shared operational parameter across tools. Use separate scoped bindings if several tools intentionally require fixed inputs. Never prescribe IDs for products that do not yet exist.
","/fields/operation_guides/computational_mission":"MechCAL provides computationally supported preliminary mechanism judgments to
scientists. Experimental measurements are not available in this task. Compare
mechanisms through the available computational experiments and explain what the
results support. Missing wet-lab confirmation bounds a conclusion; it is not by
itself a reason to stop, reject useful computed evidence, or demote a candidate.
Do not confuse a calculated property or trend with proof of an operating mechanism.

Execution status comes from runtime. A completed calculation can leave its
scientific question inconclusive. In questions, assessment=distinguished means
the question itself has a bounded answer, not merely that a route ran. Use
inconclusive for an unresolved comparison, including when status is deferred or
resolved as a workflow disposition. Null means not assessed; legacy resolved
questions with null assessments still need consideration, not automatic clearance.

When scope/parent_id are recorded, a distinguished child test does not settle its
parent mechanism question. Consider the unresolved parent and relevant contenders
outside the Top-3. Complementary mechanisms need not defeat one another. In
question_evidence, compare actual execution conditions against the planned
contrast; different methods or optimized geometries are not matched controls.
Missing conditions remain unknown. Distinguish a useful next contrast from a
redundant test or a capability gap. Keep this in the existing bounded review,
not another required report or a demand for every question to be resolved.

Before delivery, review remaining computational opportunities against the live
tool_catalog. Do not infer all tools' abilities from one heuristic or a familiar
package name. ready permits an attempt, not guaranteed success. Missing input may
be obtainable by another available preparation step. Describe unfamiliar routes
before declaring that no available computation addresses a comparison.
Useful calculations may raise, lower, or leave candidate confidence unchanged.
Do not force new labels, all-tool coverage, confidence thresholds, or fixed rounds.

Only final_reviewer returns next_computations. Other Reviewer roles keep their
existing text/findings interface; do not add this field to those operations.
Final Reviewer: use the existing final review to identify at most three material next
computations, explaining what alternatives they could distinguish. These are
advice, not execution requests. Different comparisons may use the same tool;
different tool IDs do not establish independent evidence. Consider meaningful candidates beyond the current
Top-3, including deferred and formerly resolved comparisons. If no calculation
would help, return next_computations=[] and explain the computational reason,
not merely the absence of experiment. With unchanged computational_review.basis,
reuse its previous suggestions with next_computations=null; wording-only edits
do not require repeating exploration review. Tool metadata is not evidence.

candidate_comparison separates case-specific interpretations from source lineage
for the whole pool. In this same bounded review, compare unresolved contenders
against the same relevant observations, including candidates outside the Top-3.
State which explanations a shared observation distinguishes, which remain
compatible, and whether an available computation could separate them. Keep this
in the existing review text/findings and next_computations, not an extra report
or mandatory per-label checklist. Read alternative sources when relevant; lack
of a measurement is not a negative result. A failed narrow explanation does not
redefine or disprove its broader mechanism family. If available computations
cannot separate the explanations, recommend a provisional ordering with that
uncertainty. Reuse the current review when its basis has not changed.

Planner: when final review suggests a route, perform a useful computation, choose
an alternative, or explain why the suggestion would not distinguish the candidates.
To submit the saved draft instead, use route_responses for the current suggestions.
Give one response per distinct capability, addressing all its proposed comparisons.
Disagreement is allowed. Do not use an unavailable or unexecuted calculation as
negative evidence. Retain unresolved mechanisms and communicate the preliminary
ranking and the remaining discriminating questions without repeating all history.

content.text:
We need pick investigation. First update_hypotheses must set initial candidate confidences/explanations and investigation choice. Need decide initial priorities.

Molecule: Au(I) isocyanide complex with pentafluorophenyl. Known class: "mechanochromic luminescence" of gold isocyanide complexes? Specifically [Au(C≡N-Ar)(C6F5)] with alkoxy chains, forms columnar liquid crystals? These are luminescent liquid crystals, aurophilic interactions. Photophysics governed by metal-perturbed intraligand CT, aggregation, packing.

SMILES is neutral? [N+]#[C-]->[Au] bonded to C6F5, so Au(I) linear two-coordinate: isocyanide and pentafluorophenyl. No aurophilic intermolecular in monomer but possible in aggregate. The decyloxy chain adds rotors and lipophilicity, promotes aggregation/crystalline packing.

Mechanisms likely:
1. PACKING_HOST_MATRIX_CONFINEMENT — solid/aggregate packing restricts geometry and enables emission; this molecule likely displays AIE or mechanochromism. Strong structural prior (long alkoxy tail, Au aryl).
2. RIM_RIR_RIV — decyloxy chain and aryl torsions; restriction of rotation reduces nonradiative decay.
3. TRIPLET_METAL_ENERGY_TRANSFER — Au heavy atom; but two-coordinate Au(I) with no aurophilic contact may have weak SOC. Yet luminescence often phosphorescence from triplet metal-to-ligand CT. Need computational compare singlet-triplet.
4. ICT_TICT_CT — donor alkoxy phenyl to electron-poor isocyanide-Au-C6F5; strong push-pull. HOMO on alkoxy phenyl, LUMO on isocyanide/Au/C6F5. Likely low-energy CT state. Could be top.
5. RADIATIVE_RATE_STATE_BALANCE — computed oscillator strengths.

Need at least three mechanisms. Could rank CT, packing, RIM. But need molecule-specific computational evidence. Baseline/frontier/CT descriptors can support CT. Ground-state geometry plus torsions can quantify donor-acceptor twist, alkoxy rotors. Baseline excitation can show dominant transitions and oscillator strength. Triplet comparison can support metal triplet.

Our first delegated bundle should cover:
- optimize_ground_state_geometry
- run_baseline_bundle
- extract_ct_descriptors_from_bundle
- run_frontier_orbital_partition
- analyze_hole_electron_from_bundle
- compare_singlet_triplet_states maybe needs geometry, can handle Au with TD-DFTB mio? Catalog says TD-DFTB/mio-1-1 CHNO? It might not support Au. Wait compare_singlet_triplet_states description: "TD-DFTB/mio-1-1" likely CHNO only, no Au. compare_spin_states_pyscf uses def2 with scalar Au ECP, better for Au. But maybe heavy. We can use compare_spin_states_pyscf to get S/T. That's 1 computation and supports triplet. The capability "compare_spin_states_pyscf" fixed-geometry singlet/triplet with DF-PBE or DF-PBE0/TDA, def2 basis and Au ECP. This is ideal. But does it need geometry artifact. Yes.

Could authorize all in one worker task with sequence. Max computations 4. Worker should use:
1. optimize_ground_state_geometry (source_artifact_id structure:initial; maybe charge 0, multiplicity 1)
2. run_baseline_bundle (prepared structure)
3. extract_ct_descriptors_from_bundle (bundle)
4. analyze_hole_electron_from_bundle (bundle) OR compare_spin_states_pyscf (prepared geometry). That's 4. Frontier orbital partition maybe baseline already provides? extract_ct_descriptors reads dominant transitions and Mulliken charges, which gives CT. Frontier orbital partition adds orbital composition. Which is more useful to distinguish ICT vs triplet? compare_spin_states gives triplet energies and oscillator strengths. Important given Au. We could perhaps skip baseline bundle and run targeted via compare_spin_states; but need singlet excitation energies/oscillator strengths too. Baseline gives S1 and bright/dark ordering. compare_spin_states_pyscf gives S1-S3/T1-T3 oscillator strengths likely. Could perhaps skip run_baseline and use compare_spin_states_pyscf only, then extract_ct needs bundle no.

Maybe delegate objective with 4 computations:
- optimize
- run_baseline_bundle
- extract_ct_descriptors
- compare_spin_states_pyscf

This covers CT and triplet. No hole-electron quantitative. CT descriptors may include donor/acceptor, charge transfer length? The catalog says "Read existing excited states, dominant transitions and ground-state Mulliken charges". Enough to see if S1 is CT by orbital parentage and Mulliken changes. Frontier orbital partition could be more direct but baseline may include frontier orbitals? Let's inspect exact tool documentation. We have describe_tools remaining 2, can load 6 capabilities. Need know parameters. Let's describe optimize_ground_state_geometry, run_baseline_bundle, extract_ct_descriptors_from_bundle, compare_spin_states_pyscf, run_frontier_orbital_partition, analyze_hole_electron_from_bundle. That may be large but okay. Description is not scientific read? It's tool docs. Use 1 batch.

tools.description: Delegate a computational objective and explicit scope to a Worker. The Worker can diagnose and retry within that scope; Planner retains scientific judgments.

tools.name: update_hypotheses

labels.description: Null or omission retains the saved field. New questions require labels and question. May be omitted for no change.

question.description: Null or omission retains the saved field. New questions require labels and question. May be omitted for no change.

next_test.description: Null or omission retains the saved field. New questions require labels and question. May be omitted for no change.

outcomes.description: How possible results would affect the candidates, including an inconclusive result. Null or omission retains the saved field. New questions require labels and question. May be omitted for no change.

status.description: Null or omission retains the saved field. New questions require labels and question. May be omitted for no change.

scope.description: Scope of the question, not its answer. Null/omission retains the saved value; legacy scope is unknown. Null or omission retains the saved field. New questions require labels and question. May be omitted for no change.

parent_id.description: Optional broader question ID in this case. Null/omission retains it; empty string detaches. Answering this question never answers its parent automatically. Null or omission retains the saved field. New questions require labels and question. May be omitted for no change.

relation.description: Planner's interpretation of the named candidates for this question, not a taxonomy rule. Null/omission retains the saved value. Null or omission retains the saved field. New questions require labels and question. May be omitted for no change.

Null or omission retains the saved field. New questions require labels and question. May be omitted for no change.

assessment.description: Scientific answer to this question, separate from whether a calculation finished. Null means not assessed, including legacy records. Execution success never implies distinguished. Null or omission retains the saved field. New questions require labels and question. May be omitted for no change.

route.description: Optional exact available route for this comparison; not an executable request. Parameters are supplied to the computation tool separately. Null or omission retains the saved field. New questions require labels and question. May be omitted for no change.

disposition_reason.description: Why a test is deferred or the comparison is resolved, if applicable. Null or omission retains the saved field. New questions require labels and question. May be omitted for no change.

clear_fields.description: Explicitly clear these optional fields. Do not also supply a non-null replacement for them. May be omitted for no change.

considered_question_ids.description: Other saved comparisons actually considered, not a list of all mechanisms or a required coverage quota.

reason.description: Briefly compare the information expected from the next experiment with the alternatives, or explain why remaining feasible comparisons do not justify continuing. Scientific disagreement is allowed.

baseline_refs.description: Existing case-local inputs or results for comparison, not copied measurements.

confidence.description: Current subjective confidence, not calibrated probability. Null means unassessed, not zero.

explanation.description: Current case-specific physical explanation for this family, separate from confidence-change notes. Null or omission retains the previous explanation; empty string clears it. This is interpretation, not evidence.

question_id.description: Saved question selected for investigation; null for preparation or open exploration, and for conclusion.

considered_question_ids.description: Other saved comparisons actually considered, not a list of all mechanisms or a required coverage quota.

reason.description: Briefly compare the information expected from the next experiment with the alternatives, or explain why remaining feasible comparisons do not justify continuing. Scientific disagreement is allowed.

note.description: Brief assessment of the available new results, or why confidence remains unchanged or unresolved.

responses.description: May be omitted for no change.

questions.description: May be omitted for no change.

messages.content:
You are MechCAL's scientific Planner. Use the supplied SMILES, fixed mechanism
pool and case-local computational evidence to produce a bounded preliminary
mechanism ranking. No papers, hidden reference, judge feedback or rubric are
available. Experimental measurements are not available; use computational evidence.
Scientific decisions remain yours; Reviewer and Worker outputs are
advice, not verdicts. Compare credible explanations, what has weakened, and which
next observation could distinguish alternatives, including those outside Top-3.
Mechanisms can coexist. Do not force a new label, confidence movement, exhaustive
tool coverage or a fixed number of rounds. Missing wet-lab confirmation bounds
the claim; it alone neither invalidates computation nor demands more work.

CURRENT WORK
This is the current task view, not a restart. It includes the current assessment,
new-result addresses, active issues, authorized input addresses and retained
facts. Earlier API requests are not implicit memory. Use the delivered working
facts and latest operation result; retrieve missing context rather than assume
you remember it. Omitted data is not absent, zero, refuted or approved. Candidate
confidence and experiment value are different. A failed explanation does not
disprove its entire mechanism family. Consider useful controlled comparisons,
redundant tests and real capability gaps before stopping.

READS AND DOCUMENTATION
Native function schemas and operation_groups define available operations and
batching. Detailed manuals are stored at context:planner under
/fields/operation_guides/<name>, with names in operation_guide_names. Read an
exact needed manual using read_evidence, or read_context for a named background
field. Do not fetch the entire background to acknowledge an update. In a query
continuation, the smaller catalog is navigation, not full tool documentation.
describe_tools loads exact parameter contracts, prerequisites and output meaning.
Missing inputs may be obtainable with another allowed preparation tool; ready
permits an attempt, not guaranteed success. Read unfamiliar route details before
declaring a capability gap. Deferred material remains accessible, not prechecked.

Copy record IDs exactly. Keep IDs and JSON-pointer paths separate. Index rows
are navigation, not observations. Use report_ref/brief_read for a compact report;
report fields differ from raw result paths. For large sources, inspect a
directory then read relevant paths or a page. Respect operation_policy and the
remaining query allowance. Workspace reads do not refill scientific queries.
Use exact source-bound numerical operations when needed, not invented arithmetic.
same_text_at and same_data_at are exact request-local pointers, not citations.

ASSESSMENT AND COMPUTATION
Before experiments and after each result group, use update_hypotheses to maintain
the provisional assessment. Update changed entries only; an empty change list
can explicitly retain it. Confidence is subjective, may stay null/unchanged and
need not sum to one. Keep case-specific explanations, not just labels. Address
relevant impact suggestions as reviewed, deferred or dismissed; omission leaves
them pending. Use brief questions and planned contrasting outcomes when useful,
not as a mandatory checklist. A narrow child test does not settle its parent
mechanism question. New observations can affect several mechanisms at once.

When investigation_policy is present, record investigate or conclude with a
brief reason in update_hypotheses.investigation. An investigate choice may use a
saved question or null for preparation. Evaluate new proposal_decision options
by possible outcomes, not just previous argument approval. Choosing does not
execute. operation_groups may allow the update followed by a computation or one
control in the same response; use that instead of a separate acknowledgement.
Only requested native functions execute, never prose next_test suggestions.

Choose tools, atom selections, scientific parameters and existing artifact IDs
explicitly. The runtime never invents inputs or substitutes tools. Independent
batched computations cannot consume a sibling's future result. For delegation,
select an owner, authorized capabilities and input_refs including the starting
structure. Bind scientific conditions such as state or multiplicity. Scope
operational source IDs to their own capability, not every downstream tool. A
Worker can diagnose execution failures within that authorization, not change the
scientific question. Failed calculations are limitations, not negative physical
evidence. Pending experiments remain visible: explicitly retry or cancel them.

EVIDENCE AND REVIEW
Cite original observations in refs; input:smiles can support structural priors.
Put failed/unavailable operations in limitation_refs only. Reports, explanations,
manuals, reviews and remembered judgments are not new observations. Bind numeric
claims to their own source paths, execution conditions and actual status. Parent
result paths do not belong to a child evidence unit. Reuse of a result or a
derived score is not independent confirmation. Unrecorded conditions remain
unknown; optimized structures or different methods are not matched controls.
Computation success does not mean the scientific comparison is distinguished.

Formal arguments and rankings are separate from provisional assessment. Submit
only changed records, with linked argument/ranking changes in one transaction.
Explanations belong in arguments, rankings link argument_ids. Omitted records
persist; null edit fields are unchanged and [] clears a list. Accepted edits
stay accepted after reads. Correct related factual errors together. Science
disagreements and optional wording are not mandatory correction gates. Only
Reviewer closes tracked issues. request_review is for needed scientific review,
not copy-editing or acknowledgement. Full prior advice is readable when previewed.

LOCAL ERRORS AND DELIVERY
Each operation result says what executed or committed; an assistant request is
not proof of success. Correct rejected fields, choose another route or state the
limitation. For judgment_draft use repair_judgment on displayed change indices
or discard_judgment; the draft is uncommitted and repairs are atomic. These
native repair tools are version-bound by runtime. Consult the saved exact fields
instead of repeating correct paragraphs. Ordinary errors do not erase evidence.

When further feasible comparisons would not materially improve the judgment,
record a conclude choice and retain unresolved alternatives honestly. finalize
saves a concise narrative alongside predictions assembled from accepted claims.
amend_final edits a saved draft; review_final retries its review without rewriting.
submit_final delivers the exact reviewed draft_id. Changed content needs review
again, but review is advisory, not approval. Address final route suggestions in
route_responses, accepting or declining with a computational reason. Do not claim
an available route is unavailable just because you chose not to run it. Consult
the exact operation guide for unfamiliar editing or submission details.
